previousBulletins: The passes are closed. The blizzard that hit the Wailing Moth country last week shows no sign of leaving, and Harrow Teeth raiders are making the most of travellers who cannot leave either.
The Thistle Commonwealth has opened its granaries to anyone who can reach them. The catch, as always on the rim, is reaching them.

reporter.name: Tomas Quell
reporter.persona: earnest, plain-spoken and quick to worry

handoff.plotSummary: Constance learned from a letter that her sister Ada, lost for thirty years, was alive in a Wailing Moth village. She led a caravan through the passes to bring Ada home. A blizzard caught them; the caravan was lost, and Constance died of cold. Ada is still in the village.
